publishedAllUserChatMessage.contract: Both profiles: List returns chatMessageCollectionResponse with optional OData queries; Get returns chatMessage with optional select/expand; Get1 returns an inline pageable value:chatMessage[] collection with optional model plus OData queries. No spec-defined headers on these GETs.

The literal [A-Z]* suffix selects the beta TeamDefinition node, not its mixed-case descendant nouns. v1.0 has no such node.

GET user chat message list/item AND zero-argument aggregate function all share AllUserChatMessage. The metadata oracle stores only the first Get URI; it cannot justify dropping the aggregate URL.
